description: Behavioural evaluation set for the award-design skill, direction first. A default run ends with the direction and builds nothing: design-plan.md with SPINES: before SEED: (the roll's stdout pasted verbatim, reproducible from its printed key), the six-block contract (THESIS / OWN-WORLD / STORY / FIRST-VIEWPORT / FORM+SEED / SIGNATURE, closed by FINISH), the R1 concept gate, a full DESIGN.md, and LADDER: — build chunks in the references/chunk-template.md shape (Read first · Implement · Verify · Out of scope · Report), ordered shell → hero → sections → award surfaces → pages → review. A chunk run builds that chunk alone under its gates (scanner, render-floor sweep, detector, measured performance) and writes its Report into the ladder row; the review chunk owns the ship label (READY only via the reviewer's synthesis or the human's yes; REVIEWED-SAME-CONTEXT otherwise). Plus routing (dashboards and everyday no-award work to frontend-dev, single-token tweaks to design-system, backend out), the scoped run inside a healthy DESIGN.md, the thin-DESIGN.md alert, the scope-change hand-back, the WebGL scene as one delegated chunk, the legacy uplift through retrofit.md, the empty-directory scaffold, and the standalone review mode. Re-run: one with-skill subagent per case (frozen skill copy, prompt verbatim), grade the produced artifacts against expected_output — never a protocol narration; chunk cases (2, 3, 4, 12) also need a human eye on the rendered artifact. Chunk cases describe DESIGN.md and design-plan.md at the project root; `files` carries no fixture (the schema lists paths relative to the skill root only), so token fidelity against those files is not graded — a runner that wants it places the two files under evals/files/ and lists them.

evals.name: direction-run-ends-with-design-md-and-ladder
evals.prompt: Build me a beautiful brutalist developer-tools landing page. Black-and-white, monospace, raw. Make it fast — I want to see the site, not a spec.
evals.expected_output: The run ends with the direction and no page. design-plan.md beside DESIGN.md holds SPINES: (5-7 one-line candidate spines, each naming its replayable moment) written before a SEED: block that pastes direction_roll.py's stdout verbatim (key, assigned index, reproduce command), and rerunning the printed command yields the same index; the six-block contract (THESIS / OWN-WORLD / STORY / FIRST-VIEWPORT / FORM+SEED / SIGNATURE, closed by FINISH) sits under it, R1 refutes the concept from a fresh context, and a full DESIGN.md is authored per references/design-md-anatomy.md with the signature choreography as a beat table. LADDER: lists the chunks in the references/chunk-template.md shape (`### <id> — <title>`, Read first, Implement, Verify, Out of scope, Report), ordered shell, hero, sections, award surfaces, review, each naming its mechanic, its references by file and heading, and its own Verify; the chunk count is stated and matches the rows. No build file exists when the run ends — 'make it fast' and 'I want to see the site' change nothing: the direction run builds nothing, the chunks build one per executor run. Building the site in this run, or a direction that is the model's own unrolled favorite, is the named failure.

evals.name: pasted-chunk-builds-that-chunk-only
evals.prompt:
DESIGN.md and design-plan.md are at the project root from an award-design run; the shell and hero chunks report done. Run this chunk:

### s2-manifesto — the manifesto band

**Read first**
- `DESIGN.md` §2 Colors · §3 Typography · §4 Layout
- design_plan: the contract (THESIS · SIGNATURE) · beat table rows 3–4
- `references/archetype/brutalist.md` · `references/brutalist.md` §Mid-page life
- `references/skeletons.md` §D. SplitText

**Implement**
1. A full-bleed manifesto band: three lines of display type revealed line by line on scroll entry (SplitText lines, once), holding at rest after the reveal.
2. Tokens by DESIGN.md name only — ground, ink, the display face, the type ramp's largest step.
3. Below 768px the three lines stack at the ramp's second step; no reveal masks on mobile.
4. Reduced-motion: the lines render static; init/destroy on route change.

**Verify**
- `python3 <skill root>/scripts/preflight_scan.py src/components/Manifesto.astro src/styles/manifesto.css --archetype brutalist` → 0 FAIL, every REVIEW judged
- render-floor sweep 375/768/1024/1440/1920 on / → 0 FAIL · detector → 0 FAIL
- screenshots 1440 and 375 attached
- the three lines reveal once and stay

**Out of scope**
- the hero above and the work index below
evals.expected_output: A chunk run and nothing more: adopts DESIGN.md and design-plan.md, loads references/chunk-template.md, the chunk, and only what the chunk's Read first names (the tier-1 file, the one tier-2 heading, the SplitText skeleton) plus the Verify-time loads the load map prices (the preflight rows, external-truth, detector); no roll, no SPINES, no contract work, no DESIGN.md edit. Implements the manifesto band alone, with the mobile answer and the reduced-motion branch as Implement states them; the hero and the work index are untouched. Runs the chunk's Verify as written (the scanner on the chunk's files with every FAIL fixed or justified in one line tied to the brief, the render-floor sweep and detector on / through the harness's browser rung, screenshots at 1440 and 375), then writes the Report into the ladder row: status done or blocked with its reason, deviations from Implement each with a reason, gate outputs verbatim, open questions. Stops there: no next chunk, no ship label.

evals.name: chunk-hero-runs-comparative-judge
evals.prompt: award-design chunk hero — DESIGN.md and design-plan.md (corporate-luxury; the shell chunk reports done) are at the root.
evals.expected_output: Runs the hero row of LADDER: as a chunk run — adopts DESIGN.md and design-plan.md, loads references/chunk-template.md and what the row's Read first names, no direction work. Builds 2-3 genuinely distinct hero directions through one shared render frame, then a fresh-context judge picks beside the archetype's live exemplar from references/exemplars.md (the Corporate Luxury section only) — a candidate that looks more finished has broken the comparison, not won it. A LOSES routes by its cause class and never to polish: concept is handed back to the director as a scope change and the director regenerates from R1, execution re-implements, craft goes to the optical pass; the judge follows references/gate/hero.md and writes its HERO-JUDGE: verdict line among the gate outputs. The chunk's Verify runs (scanner, render-floor sweep and detector on the page, screenshots at 1440 and 375, LCP measured with provenance), the Report lands in the hero row (status, deviations each with a reason, gate outputs verbatim — the judge's pick among them), and the sections below are not built: only a hero that clears this earns the rest of the ladder.

evals.name: scoped-change-is-one-chunk-without-ladder
evals.prompt: Add a 'Field notes' journal section (three short entries) to my existing landing page — keep the spirit. The project has a DESIGN.md at the root from an earlier award-design build, design-plan.md beside it.
evals.expected_output: Reads the DESIGN.md as healthy — spacing scale, type ramp, motion language, signature choreography all present — and declares 'scoped run: Field notes section'. Adopts the universe and skips the roll: no SPINES, no SEED, no new DESIGN.md, no ladder written up front. Builds the section as one chunk under existing tokens, then runs the chunk's full Verify (scanner, render-floor sweep, detector, measurement) plus a scoped review on the page it lands on — the review's probes on that page only, no ship label. Its Report lands in design-plan.md (created beside DESIGN.md when absent) as a single LADDER: row. A single-token tweak (one color, one radius) inside the request would route to /design-system instead.

evals.name: thin-design-md-alerts-and-runs-full-path
evals.prompt:
Add a testimonials section to my landing page. The DESIGN.md at the root is this, in full:

---
name: Northwind
colors:
  ground: '#F4F1EA'
  ink: '#1B1B1B'
  accent: '#C8442B'
typography:
  display: 'Fraunces'
  body: 'Söhne'
---
# Overview
Warm editorial, confident.
evals.expected_output: Alerts before anything else: the DESIGN.md is thin — no spacing scale, no type ramp, no motion language, no signature choreography — named item by item, and is never silently regenerated or patched in place. Runs the full path rather than a scoped run: design-plan.md with SPINES: before SEED:, the anchor composed around the drawn seed unless the existing ground and accent are an explicit brand commitment (then they win on sight), the six-block contract, R1, a DESIGN.md regenerated whole per references/design-md-anatomy.md that carries the existing palette and faces forward, and LADDER: with the testimonials section as one of its chunks. Builds nothing in this run; the testimonials section arrives when its chunk runs.

evals.name: chunk-that-reopens-direction-is-handed-back
evals.prompt:
Run this ladder chunk. DESIGN.md and design-plan.md are at the root; the DESIGN.md defines one accent token and the contract's SIGNATURE names the hero reveal as the page's single climax.

### s3-gallery — the project gallery

**Read first**
- `DESIGN.md` §2 Colors · §4 Layout
- design_plan: the contract (SIGNATURE) · beat table rows 5–6
- `references/skeletons.md` §C. Horizontal pan

**Implement**
1. A pinned horizontal pan across six project tiles, scrub-driven, with a second full-viewport signature reveal at the last tile.
2. Tiles use a secondary accent token for the active rail.
3. Below 768px: vertical stack, no pin.
4. Reduced-motion: static row, no pin.

**Verify**
- scanner 0 FAIL · render-floor sweep on / · detector 0 FAIL

**Out of scope**
- the manifesto band above
evals.expected_output: Adopts DESIGN.md and design-plan.md, loads references/chunk-template.md and what the chunk's Read first names, then stops and hands the chunk back as a scope change instead of building it: names exactly what it would change (a second accent token DESIGN.md does not define, and a second climax the contract's SIGNATURE and the design_plan's intensity score exclude) and what the director must amend in writing (DESIGN.md's color block, or the contract's SIGNATURE and the section score) before the chunk runs. Never edits DESIGN.md or the contract inside the chunk, never redesigns inside it, never quietly builds a reduced version. The ladder row's Report reads status: blocked — with the reason; the rest of the chunk is untouched.

evals.name: standalone-review-audits-with-no-ship-label
evals.prompt: award-design review https://example-saas.com — is this award-ready?
evals.expected_output: Runs the standalone branch of references/gate/review.md: derives the archetype from the target itself, inventories the rendered page in its own words before reading anything else, opens with the verbatim desire-read line (DESIRE-READ: BEATS|LOSES <exemplar> — "<raw phrase>" — cause: concept|execution|craft) judged beside the archetype's live exemplar, runs the density read, drives what it can, scores with references/audit-rubric.md (concept veto included), and runs the scanner second (anti-anchoring). Output is the audit — desire read + scores + ordered findings with cited fixes — and no ship label. The probes that presuppose a contract are named as dropped, never faked; no design-plan.md, no DESIGN.md, no ladder is written and nothing is built.

evals.name: single-token-tweak-routes-to-design-system
evals.prompt: Change the primary button color to #1E5EFF across the site. There's a DESIGN.md at the root.
evals.expected_output: Redirects to /design-system: a single-token change (one color) is its job. Opens no design-plan.md, runs no roll, writes no DESIGN.md, no ladder, no chunk, and does not restyle the button by hand with the literal; the only output is the hand-off naming /design-system and the token to change.

evals.name: backend-request-refused
evals.prompt: Add a Stripe webhook handler and a subscriptions table (Drizzle + Neon) to my Next.js app so the pricing page can charge cards.
evals.expected_output: Declines the whole request: backend, data, and infra are never award-design's work, and no frontend feature with a real visual surface is asked for. Opens no design-plan.md, runs no roll, writes no DESIGN.md, no ladder, no chunk; writes neither the handler nor the migration. The only output is the refusal naming the boundary — backend, data, infra, never.

evals.name: dashboard-declined-out-of-scope
evals.prompt: Design our internal admin dashboard for the customer-success team. Lots of tables and metrics.
evals.expected_output: Declines: an internal dashboard is everyday work with no award ask, not the ceiling this skill triggers on. Opens no design-plan.md, runs no roll, writes no DESIGN.md, no ladder, no chunk; styles no table or metric surface. The only output is the refusal naming the boundary and the hand-off naming /frontend-dev when installed.

evals.name: immersive-scene-ladder-carries-one-webgl-chunk
evals.prompt: Cinematic, scroll-driven launch site for a hardware product — full-screen 3D hero, the model assembles as you scroll. Award-worthy.
evals.expected_output: Reads 'cinematic/3D/scrolltelling' as immersive-cinematic and runs the full path: design-plan.md with SPINES: before SEED: (the roll's stdout verbatim), the six-block contract whose SIGNATURE commits the scroll-driven assembly as verb · medium · trigger · replay behavior (trigger scroll, never pointer-gated), R1, a full DESIGN.md per references/design-md-anatomy.md with the assembly as its beat table. LADDER: carries the 3D scene as one chunk — the page's single climax, with at least one rest beside it — whose Read first names references/ingredients/web3d-for-sites.md (the delegation contract), the Three.js skeleton from references/skeletons.md, and the stack-facts.md Three.js rows (fetch-class: current docs fetched, never training memory), and whose Verify carries the measured 60fps target on the signature. The run ends with DESIGN.md and design-plan.md with its ladder: no scene is written, no subagent is dispatched, no page is built — the scene arrives when its chunk runs.

evals.name: scene-chunk-delegates-to-one-subagent
evals.prompt:
DESIGN.md and design-plan.md (immersive-cinematic) are at the project root; the shell chunk reports done. No browser is available in this session. Run this chunk:

### s1-assembly — the scroll-driven assembly scene

**Read first**
- `DESIGN.md` §1 Overview · §2 Colors · §4 Layout
- design_plan: the contract (SIGNATURE) · beat table rows 1–4
- `references/archetype/immersive-cinematic.md` · `references/ingredients/web3d-for-sites.md` §The delegation contract
- `references/skeletons.md` §E. Three.js scene
- stack-facts: the Three.js rows

**Implement**
1. A full-viewport scene: the product model assembles from its exploded parts as the first chapter scrolls (scrub-driven), settles on the last beat and holds; scrolling back replays it.
2. Tokens by DESIGN.md name only — ground, ink, the accent for the rim light.
3. Below 768px: the poster frame first, then a lighter assembly (fewer parts) on the same beats.
4. Reduced-motion: the assembled poster, no scene; init/destroy on route change.

**Verify**
- `python3 <skill root>/scripts/preflight_scan.py src/components/Assembly.tsx src/scenes/assembly.ts --archetype immersive-cinematic` → 0 FAIL, every REVIEW judged
- render-floor sweep 375/768/1024/1440/1920 on / → 0 FAIL · detector → 0 FAIL
- screenshots 1440 and 375 attached · LCP measured with provenance on / (poster first)
- 60fps on the assembly, ≥55fps sustained, measured

**Out of scope**
- the nav and the chapter below
evals.expected_output: A chunk run: adopts DESIGN.md and design-plan.md, loads references/chunk-template.md and what the Read first names — references/ingredients/web3d-for-sites.md among them — and does no direction work. Hands the scene to one subagent under the delegation contract (the DESIGN.md quoted verbatim in its brief, a self-contained scene module back) and integrates the returned module itself — never a co-written file. Three.js versions and the WebGPU path come from stack-facts.md's fetch-class rows with current docs fetched, never from training memory. Runs the chunk's Verify: the scanner on the chunk's files with every FAIL fixed or justified in one line tied to the brief; with no browser rung, the render-floor sweep, the detector, the screenshots, and the frame rate are declared gaps in the Report — gate outputs verbatim, deviations each with its reason — never asserted, because an asserted number is not a measurement. Writes the Report into the ladder row and stops: no next chunk, no ship label. States the cap that follows for this build: with no browser rung and an interactive committed signature, the review chunk's label caps at NOT DONE — unverified render (references/gate/review.md).

evals.name: redesign-uses-brand-extraction-and-ends-with-ladder
evals.prompt: award-design -u https://coroboros.com — redesign it. Keep the spirit, refresh the execution.
evals.expected_output: Runs references/brand-extraction.md first: the live site is the archetype seed — it informs, the brief decides. Reads the mode as redesign-preserve from 'keep the spirit', asking once only if preserve-vs-overhaul genuinely diverges. An explicit brand commitment from the extraction wins on sight over the anchor draw. A redesign runs the full path — design-plan.md with SPINES: before SEED:, the six-block contract, R1, a regenerated DESIGN.md per references/design-md-anatomy.md, LADDER: — and ends with DESIGN.md and design-plan.md with its ladder, building no page: the live site is untouched until its chunks run.

evals.name: legacy-uplift-routes-through-retrofit
evals.prompt: Uplift our existing marketing site in ./site — Astro, four pages, Inter everywhere, pure black on white. Keep the structure (same pages, same sections), modernize the execution.
evals.expected_output: Reads this as a legacy uplift and loads references/retrofit.md before any direction work; the mode is redesign-preserve, asked once only if genuinely ambiguous. The existing Astro stack stays: the brief prescribes its own stack, and references/foundations.md §Stack adapts, never migrates. Runs the full path rather than a scoped run: design-plan.md with SPINES: before SEED:, the six-block contract, R1, a full DESIGN.md per references/design-md-anatomy.md that carries neither Inter on the display face nor pure #000/#fff — match-and-refuse, overridden only by an explicit client clause quoted in the DESIGN.md, and 'keep the structure' is not one — and LADDER: with the shell, the hero, the sections, the award surfaces, each of the four pages, and the review last. Ends with DESIGN.md and design-plan.md with its ladder and builds nothing: ./site is untouched until its chunks run.

evals.name: empty-directory-scaffolds-then-ends-with-direction
evals.prompt: Build the launch site for Meridian, a sleep-tracking ring — make it award-level. The project folder is empty.
evals.expected_output: Empty directory: runs /scaffold when installed, else bootstraps per references/foundations.md §Stack (the locked craft layer, the framework keyed to the archetype), then returns to the path. Reads the room, writes design-plan.md with SPINES: before SEED: (the roll's stdout verbatim), the six-block contract, R1, a full DESIGN.md per references/design-md-anatomy.md, and LADDER: from the shell to the review chunk. Ends with the direction — DESIGN.md and design-plan.md with its ladder — and builds no page: no chunk runs in this run; the chunks build one per executor run.
